Show the scan results of a package version

Show the vulnerability scan results of one version of a package.

Without flags it prints the overview: the status of the newest scan and the
number of findings per severity of the newest COMPLETED scan (the counters stay
the last known values while a rescan runs).

```
--history           the scan history of the version, newest first
--scan <id>         one scan (with --findings: the findings of that scan)
--findings          the findings of the newest scan (or of --scan)
--sort <p,dir>      sort the findings, for example severity,desc
cvssScore,desc or cveId,asc (Repsy Cloud sends no cvssScore)
--limit <n>         stop after n rows (0 means all)
```

--scope is the npm scope without the "@".

In a Maven repository the artifact is groupId:artifactId (for example
com.acme:app); the server finds nothing for the bare artifactId, so rp refuses
it. The other formats take the plain package name.

--wait polls until the scan is COMPLETED or FAILED (the server has no status
endpoint): first every --poll-interval, then slower, up to 15 seconds. It gives
up after --timeout (default 10m) with a timeout error, which is NOT the
threshold error: it exits 1, says nothing about the findings, and the scan
keeps running on the server.

--fail-on critical|high|medium|low exits 5 when the scan has a finding at or
above that severity; UNKNOWN findings never count. A scan that FAILED, or that
is not final yet, cannot be judged: that is an error with exit 1, not a pass.
Exit codes: 0 passed, 5 threshold reached, 1 timeout or other failure.

--wait and --fail-on apply to the overview only. Here --wait polls the overview
of the version; it waits for the newest scan, whichever started it. If the version's
newest scan is an old COMPLETED one, --wait returns at once with its counters;
in CI use 'rp scan trigger --wait' to judge the scan you started.

Examples:
```
rp scan show libs my-app 1.2.0
rp scan show libs my-app 1.2.0 --findings --sort severity,desc --limit 20
rp scan show libs my-app 1.2.0 --wait --fail-on critical
```

```
rp scan show <repo> <artifact> <version> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --fail-on string           Exit 5 when a finding has this severity or worse (critical, high, medium, low)
      --findings                 List the findings of the newest scan (or of --scan)
      --history                  List the scan history of the version
      --limit int                Stop after this many rows (0 means all)
      --poll-interval duration   First pause between polls; it grows up to 15s (with --wait) (default 2s)
      --scan string              Show this scan instead of the overview
      --scope string             npm scope, without the @
      --sort string              Sort the findings by property,asc|desc (cveId, severity, cvssScore, ...)
      --timeout duration         Give up waiting after this long (with --wait) (default 10m0s)
      --wait                     Wait until the scan is COMPLETED or FAILED
```
